artists.name: Hichkas
artists.bio: Soroush Lashkary, known professionally as Hichkas (Persian: هیچکس‎; stylized as Hichkas), is an Iranian rapper, singer and songwriter. He is widely considered as one of the founders of Iranian hip hop.

artists.name: Bahram
artists.bio: Bahram Nouraei (Persian: بهرام نورایی‎), known professionally as Bahram, is an Iranian rapper and songwriter, known for his socially conscious lyrics.

artists.name: Shayea
artists.bio: Sadegh (Sadeq) Mehrabi (Persian: صادق مهرابی‎), known professionally as Shayea (Persian: شایع‎), is an Iranian rapper and songwriter.

artists.name: Erfan
artists.bio: Erfan (Persian: عرفان‎), is a prominent Iranian rapper and songwriter who has been influential in the development of Iranian hip hop.

artists.name: Yas
artists.bio: Yaser Bakhtiari (Persian: یاسر بختیاری‎), known professionally as Yas (Persian: یاس‎), is an Iranian rapper and songwriter.

artists.name: Zedbazi
artists.bio: Zedbazi is an Iranian hip hop group formed in 2002 in Tehran.

artists.name: Ho3ein
artists.bio: Hossein Eblis (Persian: حسین ابلیس‎), known professionally as Ho3ein (Persian: حصین‎), is an Iranian rapper and songwriter.

artists.name: Pishro
artists.bio: Mohammad Jaberi (Persian: محمد جابری‎), known professionally as Pishro (Persian: پیشرو‎), is an Iranian rapper and songwriter.
